summary: Pickup inventory safety correction: available-stock adjustments leave room for outstanding reservations to be released on cancellation or expiry. This remains a release candidate, not production certification.
securityNotes: Review the release policy and security guidance before production use. No security certification or automatic patch installation is implied.
migrationNotes: No schema, configuration or dependency migration from rc.2 is required. Available quantity remains unreserved stock; edits exceeding the inventory limit after outstanding holds are included now reject. Back up merchant data/configuration and review custom code before adopting this release. No shipping checkout or automatic deployment is introduced. Existing over-capacity stock/hold inconsistencies are not rewritten automatically; an operator must reconcile available stock before retrying release.
acceptanceNotes: Fresh buyer installation, normal hosted private-input provisioning, real-phone acceptance and customized-fork upgrade acceptance remain unverified. Do not infer production readiness from this notice.
